review_type: Fresh independent source, answer-key correctness, and procedural coverage challenge

findings.finding: The Q38 answer-key and ledger source reference still cites a puzzle p4 example, although the authorized supplemental evidence is the base Government Grant card reproduction on p2 only. No p4 example is necessary to establish the expected answer.
source_backed_facts: The p2 Government Grant card explicitly adds one research station to any city with no City card needed.
Any city supports placement away from the playing player without using puzzle mechanics.
findings.required_correction: Remove the p4 example reference from the answer key and coverage ledger; retain the p2 component reference.

answer_key_assessment.conclusion: All 39 expected answers are supported by the assigned core source and the specifically allowed base-component evidence. No replacement expected facts are needed.
explicit_checks: The matching PDF p2 visibly supplies the 4/3/2 setup hand counts missing from the authoritative text extraction.
The matching PDF p4 explicitly gives destination-card Direct Flight and departure-card Charter Flight; the extraction alone omits the Direct Flight instruction.
The matching PDF p6 infection-track illustration confirms the complete 2,2,2,3,3,4,4 sequence. The key currently points to the p3 board diagram; p6 is the clearer visual citation.

An Epidemic in a zero-cube city adds three without an outbreak; a nonempty city is filled to three and outbreaks. Cured alone does not suppress infection. Eradication suppresses placement but not the other Epidemic steps.
The second of consecutive Epidemics intensifies only its own newly discarded Infection card with no intervening effects, as explicitly stated by the p6 callout.
Events are barred between drawing and resolving an Infection card; the p7 double-Epidemic callout separately permits Events after the first Epidemic. The key preserves both timing rules.
The Researcher exception works only outward from her hand; the Dispatcher pays flights from his own hand, cannot direct treatment, and cannot use Operations Expert special travel.

Medic automatic removal while already present and when moved on another turn is explicitly supported; his protection is cured diseases in his own city. Quarantine Specialist protects all colors in her city and connected cities, excluding setup.

Curing the fourth disease wins immediately despite remaining cubes. Cube loss is inability to place cubes actually needed, and Player Deck loss occurs on the next required two-card draw rather than merely emptying the deck.

coverage_assessment.conclusion: I found no omitted distinct source-defined rule, outcome branch, or consequential timing/priority/exception interaction that warrants an additional question. The ledger saturation claim survives this independent challenge within the assigned 2015 core scope.

additional_candidates_rejected.reason: Q20 already limits loss to cubes actually needed; Q23/Q25 and Q32/Q33 explicitly suppress placements. This is direct application of already tested exceptions, not a new priority rule.

additional_candidates_rejected.reason: Q16 tests the per-Infection-card restriction specifically on cities that already outbreaked, chain timing, and the per-color threshold. A different adjacency graph does not add a rule.

additional_candidates_rejected.reason: The six-station supply and relocation procedure is already Q06. The two exceptions change placement location/card cost and are Q28/Q38; no separate source-defined limit exception is printed.

additional_candidates_rejected.reason: Q29 scopes once-per-turn specifically to the special travel, while Q04/Q05 cover ordinary repeatable movement. No new exception is introduced.

additional_candidates_rejected.reason: Q31 specifies automatic removal of cured colors; Q08/Q23 cover cure/last-cube eradication. This combines covered effects without a new ruling.

source_adequacy_assessment.authoritative_text: Read the full extracted/pandemic-rules.txt. It contains the complete core procedural passages but loses some embedded text, notably starting-hand numerals and Direct Flight text.
source_adequacy_assessment.matching_pdf: Inspected matching-page-1.png through matching-page-8.png and read matching-extraction.txt. The seven-role booklet is marked copyright 2015 on p8. Its procedural content matches the authoritative extraction, while its images restore missing setup, movement, and infection-track evidence.

government_grant.judgment: Adequate primary publisher reproduction of the modern base Government Grant card. Text is unambiguous: one research station, any city, no City card needed. Expansion cards elsewhere on the same page are excluded. No puzzle scenario prose was used.

forecast.judgment: Adequate primary component evidence with provenance qualification. The unobscured photograph shows the actual printed modern Forecast card: draw/look/rearrange top six Infection Deck cards and put them back on top. Its title, art, striped header, and visible text fragments match the publisher component image. The photograph is third-party hosted, so it should be described as a photograph of a publisher-printed component rather than a publisher-hosted full rule quotation. The official image alone is partly occluded and would not establish the six-card value or complete return instruction.

limitations: The main text extraction alone is insufficient for several image-only facts; retain the matching PDF evidence.
Forecast full effect relies on the readable physical-component photograph plus publisher visual corroboration.
The current answer key is adequate for the assigned base scope; this review does not claim coverage of expansion, Legacy, or unprinted edge-case rulings.
